items.title: Rotating weather / biome events that boost luck
items.detail:
Every 10-20 minutes a server-wide event runs for a few minutes (Rain: x2 luck, Night Race: NPCs faster but pads pay x2, Gold Rush: Money x3). A banner and a skybox / lighting change show it; some cars can only be rolled during an event.

Fits this game: Rolling is free and automatic, so events give players a reason to stay online at a given moment. Plugs straight into GachaConfig luck and MoneyService multipliers.
Inspired by: Sol's RNG biomes, Grow a Garden weather events

Reopened 2026-10-12: add the sky change (Atmosphere / Clouds / stars, docs/WEATHER_EVENTS_SPEC.md) and run the pending live verification.

items.title: Rebirth / prestige with a permanent multiplier
items.detail:

Rebirth is blocked during Auto Race.

Fits this game: The Speed stat already has diminishing returns, so late players stall.
Inspired by: Most idle simulators (Race Clicker, Sonic Speed Simulator)

items.title: Timed boosts (luck / money / speed potions)
items.detail:

Compact UI exposes all three potion actions and live countdown timers.

Fits this game: Gives Money a second use besides the upgrade tree and makes the turbo-luck rhythm more exciting.
Inspired by: Sol's RNG and Cars RNG luck items

items.title: Scrap duplicate cars for Money

Inspired by: Horse RNG and Grow a Garden (progress while away)

items.title: Daily login streak and rewards

Inspired by: Grow a Garden, Adopt Me!

items.title: URGENT: Lock high-speed auto racing to the track path
items.detail: High Speed can cause auto-race physics to drift wide, spin 180 degrees, and leave the track. Preserve the higher speed progression, but add an auto-race-only server-authoritative path constraint that corrects lateral offset/heading and prevents movement away from the authored route. Add a high-speed corner regression for bounded path deviation, no reversal, and no off-track exit. Compatibility-check the result with the recent UI and uncapped-speed changes before publishing. DONE 2026-10-11: rail is a cubic Hermite curve applied in PostSimulation (no heading snaps: <= 1.1 deg/stud vs ~12 before), flips and tilt are measured before the correction, race scenario has rail_heading_smooth.
